title: Gainesville Central Farm Market at Virginia Gateway
name: Gainesville Central Farm Market at Virginia Gateway
description:
Open every Saturday, rain or shine, the Gainesville Central Farm Market will feature a wide variety of fresh, local offerings, including pork, chicken, seafood, beef – locally-made charcuterie, cheeses, produce, dairy, baked goods, prepared foods to go, eggs, and flowers.
Visitors can also enjoy table seating, weekly live music, kids’ club activities, chef demonstrations, special events, and much more.
The market will be open from 9:00 a.m. to 1:30 p.m., through November 21. It will be conveniently located in the parking lot next to the Virginia Gateway building at 7500 Iron Bar Lane, with plenty of nearby parking available.
For more information, please visit the Gainesville Central Farm Market website. Sign up for the weekly e-blast to learn about market events and seasonal offerings on the website.

title: Occoquan Costume Parade & Contest
name: Occoquan Costume Parade & Contest
description:
Join the Town of Occoquan’s family-friendly Occoquan Costume Parade & Contest on Saturday, October 31 from 10:00am-12:00pm. Starting at 10:00am, Town of Occoquan Mayor Earnie Porta (aka Iron Man) will lead the parade down Mill Street to River Mill Park, where costume judging will take place. Judging categories include: cutest, scariest, funniest, most original, and family/group.
After the event concludes in the park, families are encouraged to trick-or-treat their way back through the businesses in historic downtown Occoquan.
Parade participants will line up near the Riverwalk Shops at 125 Mill Street by 10:00am. The 100 through 400 blocks of Mill Street will be briefly closed on a rolling basis between 10:00-10:30am.
There is no fee to participate. This event is open to everyone!​ No advance registration is necessary.

title: Harvest - Fall Vendor Event
name: Harvest - Fall Vendor Event
description:
Fall festival meets small business celebration! Join Common Ground for HARVEST on Saturday, Oct. 31 from 10AM–2PM at Wyndham Garden Manassas

HARVEST is here — and if you know Common Ground, you know we WE DO IT BIG. 🎃

Mark your calendars, Prince William County — Saturday, October 31 from 10AM–2PM at Wyndham Garden Manassas (10800 Vandor Lane, Manassas, VA), we're throwing our fall festival and small business celebration all in one.

This is Common Ground's Harvest season, and it's free, family-friendly, and built for the whole community — kids, neighbors, small business owners, all of it.

Here's what's waiting for you:

For the kids: face painting, pumpkin painting, a fall craft-making table, and yes — trick-or-treating with our vendors. Costumes encouraged!

For the adults: shop local, get a head start on holiday gifting, and find that one-of-a-kind treasure you didn't know you needed.

Plus — every guest who RSVPs gets 1 entry into our raffle, and the first 100 guests through the door walk away with a swag bag.

This is what Common Ground is about: connecting community and cultivating opportunity, one season at a time.

Come shop, come play, come be part of it.

RSVP is free — but swag bags go fast.

Let us know you are coming: ymscommonground.com

🎃 Costumes welcome. Bring the whole family.

A family-friendly Halloween celebration in the heart of Old Town!
Celebrate Halloween with the community at Old Town Manassas Fall-O-Ween on the Manassas Museum Lawn. This beloved fall tradition brings together families, kids, pets, and neighbors for a day full of costumes, shopping, and seasonal fun.
Enjoy a kids costume parade and contest, a pets costume parade and competition, explore a festive marketplace, and treat yourself to holiday sweets, desserts, and handcrafted goodies. It’s the perfect way to spend Halloween day with friends, family, and furry companions.
